description.name: Entry
description.text: 15 single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Awoken Samurai], and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Weakness +9% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] and [50% Critical (15s)]/[100% Critical (15s)] to all allies with 0-3/4+ XV allies

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Awoken Samurai
description.text: Samurai abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses
